crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Citation Graphs Over Time
children.blurb: Citation graphs over time are directed networks in which each node is a research work and each edge is a citation, with a timestamp that records when the citing work appeared.

children.name: Clustering Papers by Meaning
children.blurb: Clustering papers by meaning groups research documents according to what they argue, show, or investigate, rather than by surface features such as shared citations, author overlap, or keyword matches.

children.name: How a Paper Is Cited
children.blurb: How a paper is cited covers the conventions and mechanics by which a research work is referenced in later literature, including bibliographic fields, in-text citation forms, and the role of citation indexes in tracing influence.

children.name: Bridge Studies Between Fields
children.blurb: Bridge studies between fields examine research that draws on methods, data, or concepts from two or more disciplines.

children.name: Forecasting Research Trends
children.blurb: Forecasting research trends in citation mapping and discovery means using the structure of scholarly references to spot which questions, methods, and communities are gaining momentum before they become obvious.

sections.body: Citation mapping and discovery is the use of AI to trace how research papers reference one another, group papers by meaning, and find paths through the literature. In practice, systems build citation graphs from metadata, extract text and claims, and train models to predict links or cluster topics. AI helps rank related work, detect influential papers, and surface connections that a keyword search would miss. It also supports literature reviews by showing which papers cite a method, which papers challenge it, and where fields overlap. The work is not just search, it is structure discovery across a growing record of publications. The pages in this section follow that work from raw links to meaning and then to forecasts.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: Some parts are mature: citation graphs are well established, and basic clustering by text similarity works at scale. Citation context extraction, meaning whether a paper is cited as support, contrast, or background, is harder and often noisy. Bridge studies and trend forecasting remain partly speculative because citation patterns lag real advances and reflect social factors as much as scientific ones. With 135 research papers in this library, the maps are illustrative rather than comprehensive. The honest limits are coverage, disambiguation of authors and papers, and the gap between citation counts and actual influence. Links here go to the original paper rather than to a search tool, so a reader can check the source.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: The page on Citation Graphs Over Time shows how links accumulate and change across years, which is useful for seeing lineage and bursts of activity. Clustering Papers by Meaning groups work by topic rather than by exact words, so a reader goes there to find nearby papers that use different terminology. How a Paper Is Cited explains citation context, which matters when a high count hides criticism or passing mention. Bridge Studies Between Fields traces work that connects two areas, and it is the place to look for interdisciplinary links. Forecasting Research Trends projects where attention may move next, with the caveat that forecasts are guesses informed by data. Together these pages move from raw links to meaning, then to context, then to cross field bridges and forward looking signals.
